title: Show transposed key in header
prompt:
In lib/screens/songs/song_page_screen.dart, make these three exact replacements.

Replace:
import '../../utils/snackbar.dart';
with:
import '../../utils/chordpro.dart';
import '../../utils/snackbar.dart';

Replace:
                if (meta.isNotEmpty)
                  Text(
                    meta,
                    style: MonoPulseTypography.labelLarge.copyWith(
                      color: context.mp.textSecondary,
                    ),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
with:
                if (meta.isNotEmpty)
                  Text(
                    meta,
                    style: MonoPulseTypography.labelLarge.copyWith(
                      color: context.mp.textSecondary,
                    ),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                if (activeTab == _SongTab.sheet &&
                    _transpose != 0 &&
                    (song.ourKey ?? song.originalKey) case final k?
                        when k.trim().isNotEmpty)
                  Text(
                    'Original key: ${k.trim()} → ${transposeChord(k.trim(), _transpose)}',
                    style: MonoPulseTypography.labelLarge.copyWith(
                      color: context.mp.textSecondary,
                    ),
                  ),

Replace:
      onTransposeChanged: (t) => _transpose = t,
with:
      onTransposeChanged: (t) => setState(() => _transpose = t),

The original key here means the sheet's untransposed key, using the same ourKey/originalKey fallback as the existing header. The separate line keeps both keys visible when the artist and BPM fill the metadata line. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'Original key: ${k.trim()} → ${transposeChord(k.trim(), _transpose)}' lib/screens/songs/song_page_screen.dart && rg -Fq 'onTransposeChanged: (t) => setState(() => _transpose = t),' lib/screens/songs/song_page_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/songs/song_page_screen.dart && flutter test test/screens/songs/song_page_screen_test.dart
